authorities.name: Parliament of India
authorities.mandate: Supreme legislative body of the Republic of India; enacts primary statutory acts including The Patents Act, 1970, The Biological Diversity Act, 2002, The Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, and The Drugs and Magic Remedies Act, 1954.

authorities.name: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (IP India)
authorities.parent_ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce and Industry
authorities.mandate: Administers patent administration, trademark registration, designs, and geographical indications across India; promulgates procedural statutory rules and guidelines including The Patents Rules, 2003.

authorities.name: Ministry of Ayush, Government of India
authorities.mandate: Nodal Union Ministry developing education, research, quality standards, and intellectual property protection for traditional systems of medicine (Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, and Homoeopathy).

authorities.name: National Biodiversity Authority
authorities.parent_ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC)
authorities.mandate: Autonomous statutory body implementing the Biological Diversity Act, 2002; regulates access to biological resources, advises Union and State governments on conservation and sustainable use, and grants approvals for IP rights and Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS).

authorities.name: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
authorities.parent_ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)
authorities.mandate: Autonomous statutory authority under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006; regulates food product standards, Ayurveda Aahara regulations, health supplements, labeling, display, packaging, and advertising claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
authorities.mandate: Union Ministry responsible for national health policy, Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO), drug safety, cosmetics rules, and pharmacopoeial standards under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940.

authorities.name: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research
authorities.mandate: India's premier industrial R&D organization; co-developed and manages the Traditional Knowledge Digital Library (TKDL) database with the Ministry of Ayush for defensive IP protection worldwide.

authorities.name: Central Council for Research in Ayurvedic Sciences
authorities.mandate: Apex autonomous body for formulation, coordination, and development of scientific research in Ayurveda; holds patents for validated traditional Ayurvedic medical formulations and processes.

authorities.name: World Trade Organization
authorities.mandate: Multilateral international organization dealing with the global rules of trade between nations; administers the Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS) and Doha Declaration.

authorities.name: World Intellectual Property Organization
authorities.mandate: Specialized UN agency serving as the global forum for intellectual property services, policy, and cooperation; administers international treaties including the PCT, Madrid, Lisbon systems, and the WIPO GRATK Treaty (2024).

authorities.name: Secretariat of the Convention on Biological Diversity (UNEP/CBD)
authorities.mandate: Administers the multilateral treaty framework of the Convention on Biological Diversity (1992) and the Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit-Sharing (2010).

authorities.name: United States Patent and Trademark Office / US Congress
authorities.mandate: Federal agency of the United States Department of Commerce administering patent and trademark laws (The Lanham Act, 15 U.S.C.).
